Out of the said amount, a sum of Rs. 26,00,000/-
was repaid by the applicant in the year 2023 itself.

Insofar as the remaining amount of Rs. 7,07,039/- is concerned, it is submitted that the applicant is ready and willing to repay the outstanding dues,
however, the bank refused to accept the same when the son of the applicant approached the bank, on the ground that an enquiry was already underway into the alleged misappropriation and illegality on the part of the bank.

5. Taking into consideration the aforesaid submissions, which are also noted by the learned Sessions Judge in the order dated 09.10.2025, it is evident that an amount of only Rs. 7,07,039/-
remains outstanding against the loan of Rs. 30,00,000/- availed by the applicant.
6. In view of the above circumstances, I am inclined to grant interim protection to the applicant till the investigation papers are placed before this Court for perusal.

 ORDER i.
